verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server whose tools cover the whole loop. Agents can read (get threads by ID, list folders, search and filter) and triage (modify labels, bulk archive and delete). They can also draft and send (create drafts, send drafts, create and send new emails). The connection is documented, but only via a Better Auth session token, with OAuth marked 'coming soon'. Missing for 10: production-grade OAuth connection (session-token only today), explicit setup guidance for Claude/ChatGPT clients, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP end-to-end flow works.
